questions.text: Which sentence means “Aku tidak suka nasi”?
questions.discussion: Don’t like menyatakan tidak suka. Rice berarti nasi dalam konteks makanan.

questions.text: Nina says, “I like pizza.” Retell her answer using Nina’s name.
questions.discussion: Kalimat positif tentang satu orang memakai likes. Makanan yang disebut adalah pizza.

questions.text: Fajar says, “I don’t like coffee.” What can you tell a friend about Fajar?
questions.discussion: Untuk satu orang lain, bentuk negatifnya doesn’t like. Coffee tetap menjadi minuman yang dibahas.

questions.text: Ayu likes tea. Choose the sentence that replaces “Ayu” with “She” and keeps the meaning.
questions.discussion: She menggantikan Ayu dan tetap diikuti likes. Minumannya masih tea.

questions.text: Tono doesn’t like spaghetti. Choose the sentence that replaces “Tono” with “He” and keeps the meaning.
questions.discussion: He menggantikan Tono. Sesudah doesn’t, gunakan bentuk dasar like.

questions.text: Dina and Riko both like milk. How can you write this using “they”?
questions.discussion: They merujuk kepada dua orang dan diikuti like dalam kalimat positif.

questions.text: Which words complete the note? “I ___ coffee. My sister ___ coffee, too.”
questions.discussion: I memakai like, sedangkan my sister merujuk pada satu orang lain dan memakai likes.

questions.text: Which sentence says both children dislike tea?
options: Rani and Bima doesn’t like tea.
Rani and Bima don’t like tea.
Rani and Bima don’t like milk.
questions.answer: Rani and Bima don’t like tea.
questions.discussion: Dua nama bersama-sama memakai don’t like. Tea adalah minuman yang tidak mereka sukai.

questions.text: Ria wrote “My father doesn’t likes coffee.” Which edit fixes the grammar?
questions.discussion: Kata kerja setelah doesn’t harus berbentuk dasar like. Mengganti nama minuman tidak memperbaiki bentuk kata kerja.

questions.text: Put “ice cream / doesn’t like / Lila” in order to make a sentence.
questions.discussion: Nama orang yang mempunyai kesukaan diletakkan di awal, diikuti doesn’t like dan nama makanan.

questions.text: Sari likes satay. She doesn’t like pizza. What does Sari dislike?
questions.discussion: Kalimat dengan doesn’t like menunjuk pizza. Sari menyebut sate sebagai makanan yang disukai.

questions.text: Reno likes spaghetti and pizza. He doesn’t like rice. Which pair does he like?
questions.discussion: Kedua makanan setelah likes dihubungkan dengan and. Rice muncul pada kalimat negatif.

questions.text: Rina likes coffee, but Dewi doesn’t like it. What does “it” mean?
questions.discussion: It merujuk pada coffee, benda yang dibicarakan pada bagian awal kalimat.

questions.text: Lani likes bakso. Nino doesn’t like bakso. Which statement is true?
questions.discussion: Kalimat Lani memakai likes, sedangkan kalimat Nino memakai doesn’t like.

questions.text: Dito says he likes Papeda. His note also says he likes satay. Which note keeps both facts?
options: Dito likes Papeda but doesn’t like satay.
Dito likes satay but doesn’t like Papeda.
Dito doesn’t like Papeda or satay.
questions.discussion: Kedua makanan disukai Dito. And menggabungkan dua fakta positif itu.

questions.text: “Arif likes orange juice. Tia likes it, too.” Who likes orange juice?
questions.discussion: It merujuk pada orange juice. Too menunjukkan Tia memiliki kesukaan yang sama.

questions.text: Raka likes Ayam Betutu. What is true about Raka’s view of fried chicken?
questions.discussion: Catatan hanya menyebut Ayam Betutu. Kesukaan terhadap hidangan lain belum diketahui.

questions.text: Mila likes milk and doesn’t like coffee. A note says “Mila likes both drinks.” What needs to change?
questions.discussion: Catatan tentang susu sudah sesuai. Coffee harus dicatat No karena Mila tidak menyukainya.

questions.text: Choose the best question for a survey column called “Orange juice”.
options: Who drinks orange juice at lunch?
questions.discussion: Do you like menanyakan kesukaan, dan orange juice menyebut minuman yang tercantum pada judul kolom.

questions.text: Rara answers “Yes, I do” to “Do you like satay?” What should you write in her report?
questions.discussion: Yes, I do memberi jawaban positif. Laporan tentang Rara menggunakan likes satay.

questions.text: Putri’s card says “Pizza — No; Bread — Yes.” Choose a sentence about Putri that matches both marks.
options: Putri likes pizza. She doesn’t like bread.
Putri doesn’t like pizza. She likes bread.
Putri doesn’t like pizza or bread.
questions.answer: Putri doesn’t like pizza. She likes bread.
questions.discussion: No berlaku untuk pizza, sementara Yes berlaku untuk roti.

questions.text: The notes say “Ardi — tea: No; Lia — tea: No; Joko — tea: Yes.” Which two children don’t like tea?
questions.discussion: Ardi dan Lia sama-sama bertanda No. Joko bertanda Yes sehingga tidak masuk pasangan.

questions.text: Tara says, “I like tea, not coffee.” Which pair of marks matches what she says?
questions.discussion: Tea disebut sebagai yang disukai. Not coffee menolak kopi.

questions.text: You asked Niko about bread, and he said “Yes.” You have yet to ask about milk. Which report fits the information?
options: Niko likes bread. We don’t know about milk.
Niko likes bread but doesn’t like milk.
Niko likes milk but doesn’t like bread.
questions.answer: Niko likes bread. We don’t know about milk.
questions.discussion: Hanya roti yang sudah ditanyakan. Sel kosong untuk susu berbeda dari jawaban No.

questions.text: Sinta says, “I don’t like ice cream, but I like bread.” Which word shows the change from dislike to like?
questions.discussion: But menghubungkan dua gagasan yang berbeda arah, yaitu tidak suka es krim dan suka roti.

questions.text: Riko’s card says “Noodles — Yes; Fried chicken — No.” Which question can you answer with this card?
questions.discussion: Hanya mi yang tercantum di antara empat benda dalam pilihan. Tanda Yes menjawab pertanyaan tentang mi.

questions.text: “Does Lani like Papeda?” The note says “Papeda — No.” Which short answer fits?
questions.discussion: Pertanyaan tentang Lani dijawab dengan she. No pada catatan membuat jawabannya negatif.

questions.text: “Does Beni like pizza?” His note says “Pizza — Yes.” Which answer fits?
questions.discussion: Karena orang yang dibahas Beni, jawabannya memakai he. Tanda Yes menentukan respons positif.

questions.text: You want to ask Rani directly about bakso. Which sentence fits?
questions.discussion: Saat bertanya langsung kepada Rani, pakai you. She dan he dipakai saat membicarakan orang lain.

questions.text: Your friend says, “My brother likes satay.” Who likes satay?
questions.discussion: Dalam kalimat tersebut my brother adalah subjek. Tidak ada informasi kesukaan orang lain.

questions.text: Beni says, “I don’t like noodles.” Ina also says, “I don’t like noodles.” Which sentence combines the two answers?
options: Beni and Ina doesn’t like noodles.
Beni and Ina don’t like noodles.
Beni and Ina don’t like rice.
questions.answer: Beni and Ina don’t like noodles.
questions.discussion: Kedua anak memiliki jawaban negatif yang sama. Gabungan dua nama memakai don’t like.

questions.text: A label says “orange juice”. Which drink should be on that label?
questions.discussion: Juice berarti jus. Orange menerangkan buah yang digunakan, yaitu jeruk.

questions.text: Which report uses the capital letter and punctuation correctly?
questions.discussion: Nama Mila diawali huruf kapital. Kalimat yang melaporkan kesukaan diakhiri titik.

questions.text: You are making a card for a classmate. The classmate said “I like pizza.” Which mark belongs beside the pizza picture?
options: Two marks for both Yes and No
questions.discussion: I like menunjukkan jawaban positif, yang diwakili tanda centang pada kartu.

questions.text: A note says “Mira doesn’t like tea. Beni likes it.” Which survey summary is right?
questions.discussion: It masih mengacu pada teh. Mira memakai bentuk negatif dan Beni bentuk positif.
